description: This file contains functions and types for interacting with the BlueBubbles chat API, including message editing, sending typing indicators, managing group chats, and uploading group icons.

methods.name: blueBubblesPolicy
methods.description: Creates an SSR policy object based on whether private network access is allowed.

methods.name: assertPrivateApiEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the private API is enabled for the given account and feature.

methods.name: resolvePartIndex
methods.description: Resolves the part index, defaulting to 0 if undefined.

methods.name: sendBlueBubblesChatEndpointRequest
methods.description: Sends a chat endpoint request (read or typing) to the BlueBubbles API.

methods.name: sendPrivateApiJsonRequest
methods.description: Sends a JSON request to the BlueBubbles private API with appropriate headers and payload.

methods.name: editBlueBubblesMessage
methods.description: Edits a message via the BlueBubbles API, requiring macOS 13+ with Private API enabled.

methods.name: unsendBlueBubblesMessage
methods.description: Retracts (unsends) a message via the BlueBubbles API, requiring macOS 13+ with Private API enabled.

methods.name: renameBlueBubblesChat
methods.description: Renames a group chat via the BlueBubbles API.

methods.name: addBlueBubblesParticipant
methods.description: Adds a participant to a group chat via the BlueBubbles API.

methods.name: removeBlueBubblesParticipant
methods.description: Removes a participant from a group chat via the BlueBubbles API.

methods.name: leaveBlueBubblesChat
methods.description: Leaves a group chat via the BlueBubbles API.

methods.name: setGroupIconBlueBubbles
methods.description: Sets a group chat's icon/photo via the BlueBubbles API, uploading multipart form data.
